newsitem.title: ZIMBABWE: Hillary Clinton in Zimbabwe on African tour.
newsitem.headline: Hillary Clinton in Zimbabwe on African tour.

text.p: U.S. First Lady Hillary Rodham Clinton and her daughter Chelsea arrived in Zimbabwe on Friday on the third leg of a six-nation African tour.

Mrs Clinton was met at Harare International Airport by Zimbabwe Foreign Affairs Minister Stan Mudenge on arrival from South Africa for a three-day visit that includes meetings with President Robert Mugabe and some women's groups.

She is also scheduled to visit Zimbabwe's prime tourist resort, the world-famous Victoria Falls on Sunday on the two-week goodwill African tour whose main theme is to promote better health and education for African women and children.
In an arrival statement distributed to the press, Mrs Clinton also said she was keen "to see Africa's democratic and economic renewal firsthand", which was why her focus was on women.
"A democracy depends on the full integration of women into society...," she said.
Mrs. Clinton's African tour is her ninth solo trip outside the United States. The two-week goodwill mission also includes Senegal, Uganda, Tanzania and Eritrea.
